# Formation v38 integral critical normal form -- Forge handoff v0.23

Formation Polarization v38 is imported as the current full-outer finite-simple formation handoff. The v37 statement that the outer coinvariant shadow is `0` or `C2` remains correct, but v38 restores the integral depth data that shadow forgets.

For the exact v14 state `Theta(X)=(S_X,(d_{T,p}),C_X)`, criticality has three and only three normalized shapes in the full-outer finite-simple universe: a centerless simple atom; a one-species cyclic prime-power central atom; or a multi-species binary all-ones lock with one native copy of each species. In the mixed case, all active species are 2-primary and surject to residual `C2`, but the complete cyclic character code has order `2^E` with `E=max_i d_i`.

Thus Forge must retain the maximum local 2-depth even though the mixed residual line is binary. V38 also removes arbitrary projective code, relative p-adic phase, cancellation tether and section-witness features from this particular criticality branch. Those structures remain valid and nonvacuous under restricted outer actions, abstract Schur modules and broader perfect/quasisimple palettes.

The imported archive is `SOURCE/FORMATION_V38/formation-polarization-theorem-v38.0.0.zip`; its own release verifier is rerun during Forge release validation.
